title: nv-curate datasources.json
description: Site/datasource-specific curation plan consumed by nv-curate. Produced by `--action plan` and consumed by `--action curate|finetune`.

path.description: Directory holding raw report CSVs (and optionally image volumes). Relative paths resolve against the datasources.json location.

target.description: Where the AI-ready dataset is written. Omit `path` to write under the run --out directory.

steps.description: Ordered subset of the transform stages to run.

model.description: HF model id used by all live LLM stages.

task.description: Downstream AI task the curated dataset feeds.

modality.description: Image modality for the finetune datalist, e.g. 'mri_t1'.

join_key.description: Key used to join the report track to the image track.
